name: notice-board-apiary-sow-v1
description: ⭐ THE reference-v17 GAME, KEPT AS A CONTROL (14/09/2026). The shipped game of 13/09/2026 with the Apiary Notice Board's S12 power, "Sow 2 cards from your hand onto your buildings", before Dean ruled in the retext "Grow a building using the top card of any deck" (apiaryPower 'deckGrowWild'). One leaf, so on the shipped base it reproduces reference-v17's rules exactly; a paired arm against the new default reads the retext as a delta.
